# Timer:direction

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the timer direction (1 / -1)

```lua
local direction = timer:direction([direction])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

direction (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:direction(-1)
```
